scope_note: Materialized candidate inventory of the 501 exact reported forms already present in the preserved legacy source. It is NOT yet the complete all-review abbreviation registry; future paper extraction must add all abbreviations with exact evidence/locators.
evidence_locator_status: The raw TXT carries paper/reference identity but no formal evidence IDs or exact source locators. Task 4.1D does not invent them.
future_extraction_rule: Future extraction must gather all abbreviations found in every paper, preserve exact form, attach expansion only when evidenced, attach paper/evidence/locator, and keep ambiguity/aliases explicit.
evidence_driven_revision_rule: Later primary-source evidence may revise meaning, disposition, alias/collision interpretation, or taxonomy eligibility. Revisions must be explicit, evidence-backed, versioned, and historically traceable; exact raw wording and prior decisions must never be silently deleted or rewritten.
canonicalization_rule: No entry in this inventory is a canonical taxonomy term merely because it appears here.
